title: No Witness
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens No Witness and the helm marks Classroom. Do: Close on Classroom. Open wreck rights. An interceptor closes, a kite keeps range, and a raider takes whatever is flying. Nobody writes it down. Finish: come inside Classroom's shell. Red Keel heat rises. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
